description: A painted interior scene. In the foreground, a woman in a dark dress and cream headscarf holds a folded paper toward a wooden ballot box, where a man in a dark suit receives it. Behind her, a queue of women in headscarves and cardigans stands under stone arches, some holding slips of paper. Through an open door at right, a sunlit street shows minarets and palm trees. The clothing and buildings look mid-20th century, and there is no visible text, frame or wall.
